01

SureSmile links lead to missing pages

The shared menu and 35 body/tile links lead to two SureSmile 404 URLs, and a GBP post still promotes the missing treatment page.

  • Confirm whether SureSmile is still offered: restore its page if yes, or approve the general Braces fallback and exact permanent redirects if not.
  • Update the shared menu once, all mapped body links, the GBP post and llms.txt; use direct live links rather than relying on redirects.
Broken treatment URL · Broken menu alias · Broader Braces fallback · GBP post · llms.txt

October 5, 2026: 99 HTML links across 64 pages (64 shared-menu links, one global menu edit; 35 body/tile links on 29 pages), plus the GBP post and 3 llms.txt list entries. 02

Schema gives incorrect treatment and map details

Nineteen treatment Product blocks declare a $0 offer and reuse clinic reviews, while a second homepage Dentist pin sits about 1.6 km from the verified GBP pin.

  • Remove unsupported offers and clinic-wide review/rating branches; consolidate duplicate Products on Damon Ultima and Pitts Pro without deleting all business schema.
  • Use one correct Dentist pin at 39.3122463, -76.7576152 and correct the malformed X sameAs link; keep truthful treatment names and accurate business details.
Adult Orthodontics example · Damon Ultima · Pitts Pro · Exact GBP
03

Heavy animation and chat delay the homepage

The first-screen background downloads a 25.82 MB animation and a synchronous head chat loader delays parsing, with mobile lab LCP at 13.32–14.20 seconds.

  • Replace bryant-hero-bg.webp with a light static mobile poster and stop the old animation downloading; delay any retained desktop motion until after the poster.
  • Move the PartnerCenter chat loader off the parsing path using a valid supported loader, preserve its dependencies, and retest both contributors.
Exact hero file · Chat request · Retest PageSpeed
04

Some hours text and closing labels are wrong

Three service paragraphs wrongly extend Tuesday/Thursday closing to 5:30 PM instead of 5 PM, and the status script displays a wrongly converted closing time for non-Eastern visitors.

  • Change the three body summaries to Mon/Wed/Fri 9 AM–5:30 PM and Tue/Thu 9 AM–5 PM; the footer schedule is already correct.
  • Fix the status formatter's double timezone conversion and show the office's closing time with an ET label; retest Eastern and Pacific visitor contexts without changing the correct weekly schedule.
Clear Braces · Invisalign Teens · Teeth Whitening · GBP hours
05

Location names and titles have avoidable errors

Six page/field cases include incorrect city spelling, extra punctuation or reversed title wording, and shared navigation labels Owings Mills as Owing Mills.

  • Apply the exact text changes shown below in the titles, H1s and shared labels; established page URLs do not need to move for these copy fixes.
Homepage · Catonsville · Ellicott City · Owings Mills · Randallstown Invisalign · B Align
06

Useful resources need a few body links

Two educational guides mention treatment plans without linking to the existing page, and the Catonsville sleep-support page has no incoming links in the checked site.

  • Link the existing treatment plans text in the two opening evaluation paragraphs to the current Treatment Plans page; keep the guides educational.
  • If the Catonsville sleep page is retained, link it from relevant Catonsville-hub and TMJ/sleep-service body text rather than adding a top-level menu item.
Overbite guide · Teeth Shifting guide · Treatment Plans · Catonsville sleep page · Catonsville hub · TMJ/sleep service

Fix order

Resolve the broken treatment journey, inaccurate schema and loading blockers before expanding content.

  • First: decide SureSmile restoration or fallback, repair links/schema, and fix the chat loader plus homepage animation.
  • Next: correct the three hours paragraphs, geographic text and focused contextual links.
